instruction: Insert automatic page numbers in the header, aligned to the right on every page.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding automatic page numbering to the header with right alignment. The evaluator checks if page numbers exist in the header and if the header paragraph is right-aligned. Similar complexity to original task (single formatting operation).

llm_judge_reasons: Metric correctly detects automatic page number fields via XML inspection. The has_page_number_field() helper (lines 28-53) properly checks for fldChar elements and instrText containing 'PAGE' or 'NUMPAGES', which accurately distinguishes automatic fields from manual text.
Complete coverage of instruction requirements: verifies both 'automatic page numbering' (via field detection) and 'right-side alignment' (via WD_PARAGRAPH_ALIGNMENT.RIGHT check at line 74).
Proper data flow: postconfig saves file with Ctrl+S, get_vm_file extracts it, metric loads with python-docx and inspects XML structure for field codes.
Appropriate partial credit scoring: returns proportional score based on percentage of sections with valid page numbers (lines 87-91), rather than failing entirely if one section lacks headers.

Minor edge case: The phrase 'for all pages' could be interpreted strictly, but the metric checks sections with headers. In typical documents where all sections share the same header, this correctly verifies all pages. Documents with mixed header configurations are rare edge cases.
